using ll = long long;
const ll MOD1 = 998244353, MOD2 = 1000000007;
const ll POW10[] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

ll s[7], ans = 0, cnt1 = 0, n, cnt2 = -1;
vector<ll> v[7];

void dfs1(int depth, ll num) {

    cnt1++;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {

    }
}

bool isValid(ll prefix) {
    return prefix * POW10[6] + 999999 <= n && prefix * POW10[6] * 10 > n;
}

void dfs2(int depth, ll num) {
    if (num > n) return;
    if (isValid(num)) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            ll target = (cnt2 + 1 - (num * POW10[i])) % MOD1;
            if (target < 0) target += MOD1;
            ll idx = lower_bound(v[i].begin(), v[i].end(), MOD1 - target) - v[i].begin();

        }
        cnt2 += cnt1;
        return;
    }
    cnt2++;
    ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - num) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
    for (int digit = (depth == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit <= 9; digit++) {
        dfs2(depth + 1, num * 10 + digit);

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n;
    dfs1(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) sort(v[i].begin(), v[i].end());
